caption:
Good deeds wipe out evil deeds, Allah says

Allah tells us to establish prayer at both ends of the day and in hours of the night, for good deeds wipe out evil deeds. Then He tells us to be patient, for He does not let the reward of those who do good go to waste.

Surah Hud 11:114-115

Pick one prayer you will guard all week, starting tonight.

#salah #patience #surahhud #islamicreminder

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
alt_text: Establish prayer at the two ends of the day and in some hours of the night. Indeed, good deeds wipe out evil deeds. This is a reminder for those who are mindful. And be patient, for indeed Allah does not let the reward of those who do good to go to waste (Surah Hud 11:114-115)
